concepts.title: Gram Sabha Membership
concepts.definition: A village-level assembly consisting of all adults aged 18 or older who are registered as voters in that specific area.
concepts.key_idea: The fundamental unit of direct democracy where citizens engage with elected officials.
question_patterns: What is a Gram Sabha?
Who can be a member of the Gram Sabha?
Define the primary assembly of a village Panchayat.
What are the eligibility criteria for joining a Gram Sabha?
Who is allowed to vote in the village meeting?

solution_steps.explain: Verify if the individual is 18 years of age or older.
Confirm the person is a registered voter in the village area.

concepts.title: Ward Representation
concepts.definition: The division of a village into smaller zones, each electing a representative known as a Panch.
concepts.key_idea: Ensuring every part of a village has a voice in the local government.
question_patterns: What is a ward in a village?
How are ward members or Panchs elected?
Explain the division of a village Panchayat into smaller areas.
Who is a Ward Member?
How does a village ensure representation for all its parts?

solution_steps.explain: Divide the village into smaller geographical units called wards.
Voters in each ward elect one Panch to represent them.

concepts.title: The Sarpanch
concepts.definition: The presiding officer and president of the Gram Panchayat, elected by all members of the Gram Sabha.
concepts.key_idea: The executive head of the village council.
question_patterns: Who is a Sarpanch?
How is the Panchayat President chosen?
What is the role of the Sarpanch in a village?
Who leads the Gram Panchayat?
Describe the election process for the head of the village council.

solution_steps.explain: All members of the Gram Sabha vote to elect the Sarpanch.

concepts.title: Panchayat Secretary
concepts.definition: A government-appointed official who manages administrative records and organizes meetings for both the Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat.
concepts.key_idea: The administrative link between the state government and the village council.
question_patterns: What are the duties of a Panchayat Secretary?
Is the Secretary of the Gram Panchayat an elected person?
Who is responsible for keeping records of Panchayat proceedings?
How is the Panchayat Secretary appointed?
Who calls the meetings of the Gram Sabha?

solution_steps.explain: The government appoints the Secretary to the Panchayat.
The Secretary maintains minutes and records of all meetings.

concepts.title: BPL List Approval
concepts.definition: The process where the village assembly reviews and finalizes the list of households living below the poverty line to ensure fairness.
concepts.key_idea: Public oversight to prevent corruption in welfare distribution.
question_patterns: How is the BPL list finalized in a village?
Calculate the income gap for a BPL family.
What is the role of the Gram Sabha in approving the poverty list?
How much below the limit is the family income?
Find the difference between the BPL limit and actual income.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the family income from the government-defined BPL limit.

concepts.title: Gram Panchayat Functions
concepts.definition: The mandatory tasks of the village council, including infrastructure maintenance, tax collection, and executing government schemes.
concepts.key_idea: The operational responsibilities of the local government for village development.
question_patterns: What are the main works of a Gram Panchayat?
Who is responsible for maintaining village roads and water sources?
Which body executes government employment schemes in rural areas?
List the functions of the village council.
How does the Panchayat manage common property resources?

solution_steps.explain: Maintain roads, drainage, and water sources.

concepts.title: Panchayat Funding
concepts.definition: The total financial resources available to a Panchayat from taxes, government grants, and community donations.
concepts.key_idea: The financial basis for local administrative and developmental activities.
question_patterns: What are the sources of funds for the Panchayat?
Calculate the total funds of a Gram Panchayat.
How does a village council get money for its work?
Find the total income of the Panchayat from all sources.
What is the sum of taxes, grants, and donations for the village?

solution_steps.explain: Add the tax collection and government grants.
Add community donations to the subtotal to find the total funds.

concepts.title: Three-Tier Panchayati Raj
concepts.definition: The hierarchical structure of rural local government comprising the Village, Block, and District levels.
concepts.formula: tiers = gram panchayat + panchayat samiti + zila parishad
concepts.key_idea: Decentralized governance across different administrative scales.
question_patterns: What are the three levels of the Panchayati Raj system?
Name the tiers of rural local government in India.
How is the Panchayati Raj structured?
Describe the levels of democratic government in rural areas.
What is the hierarchy of the Panchayat system?

solution_steps.explain: Identify the Gram Panchayat as the first tier.
Identify the Panchayat Samiti or Janpad Panchayat as the middle tier.
Identify the Zila Parishad as the top tier.

concepts.title: Zila Parishad
concepts.definition: The district-level body that formulates developmental plans and regulates the distribution of funds among Panchayats.
concepts.key_idea: The highest administrative body in the rural local government hierarchy.
question_patterns: What is the role of the Zila Parishad?
Which body makes developmental plans at the district level?
Who regulates money distribution among Gram Panchayats?
What is the District Panchayat called?
Describe the functions of the Zila Parishad.

solution_steps.explain: Create developmental plans for the entire district.
Manage the flow of funds to the lower tiers.

worked_examples.question_pattern: If the government BPL limit is {limit} and Om Prakash's family income is {income}, what is the income gap?

solution_template.explain: Subtract income from the limit to find the deficit.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A Panchayat collects {taxes} in tax, receives {grants} from the government, and gets {donations} from villagers. What is the total fund?

solution_template.explain: Add the first two sources of income.
Add the final source to get the total.
